slice: P2 source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE group-3 description edit
scope: One runtime-authored AC1027 ASCII or binary DXF source has a root-reachable STANDARD MLEADERSTYLE with one existing group-3 description string. One transaction changes only that description to printable ASCII; the selected profile does not admit non-ASCII text or control characters.

fieldEvidence.fieldRoleSource: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference, MLEADERSTYLE group-code table identifies code 3 as MLeader Style Description
fieldEvidence.selectedTextDomain: Printable 7-bit ASCII; non-ASCII bytes and control characters are refused until a lossless code-page/Unicode profile is qualified
fieldEvidence.classification: Authoritative Autodesk DXF field-role evidence plus authored ASCII-only adapter transaction; not independent producer, Unicode/code-page, native description or consumer semantic qualification

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The selected record must be reachable through the validated ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary, have a source-matched raw body and immutable baseline, and contain exactly one existing group-3 STRING matching the typed description. The replacement must contain only printable ASCII bytes. Description must be the only changed typed payload field; identity, common fields, handles, application data, extension data and all other encoded style fields must match the source.
contract.projection: Replace only the existing physical group-3 string in a copy of the captured body. Preserve ordered fields and opaque groups. Missing/repeated group 3, raw/typed conflict, simultaneous edits, non-ASCII/control text, unknown subclass grammar and non-AC1027 routes remain outside this transaction.
contract.outputAndReadback: The focused regression covers ASCII and binary sources, same-format output, opposite-format output and fresh typed readback. It verifies exactly one emitted group-3 STRING equal to the requested printable-ASCII value. Both source/output encoding directions are covered.
contract.failureAndRetry: A raw group-3 mutation that conflicts with the typed request refuses and preserves the sentinel destination. Non-ASCII and newline-containing typed values each refuse with the sentinel intact. Restoring the captured raw body and requesting printable ASCII permits the same adapter instance to retry and pass exact output/readback checks.
contract.compatibility: Untouched MLEADERSTYLE records retain raw replay. This transaction is AC1027-only and one field per record. Other strings, non-ASCII/code-page profiles, DWG-origin writing, native description meaning and document closure are not qualified.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp emits group 3 `source-style-description` in STANDARD. All ASCII/binary sources and outputs are generated at runtime in temporary storage; no drawing fixture is committed.

focusedSelectors.summary: 2/2 passed. Group 3 checks exact raw source binding, raw-conflict refusal, Unicode/control-character refusal, same-adapter retry, exact output group, typed readback and cross-format conversion.

limitations: Evidence qualifies one authored printable-ASCII group-3 AC1027 transaction only. It does not qualify Unicode, legacy code pages, group-300 textDefault, independent producer variation, native behavior, other versions, DWG editing or complete document closure.
The support ledger remains closed; no format support claim is promoted.
